{{For|the rare version|Primed Chamber}}
'''Charged Chamber''' is a [[:Category:Sniper Mods|sniper rifle mod]] that increases the [[damage]] from the first shot fired from a fresh magazine.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Effect
! [[Mods#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +10% || 6
|-
| 1 || +20% || 7
|-
| 2 || +30% || 8
|-
| 3 || +40% || 9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*'''Charged Chamber''' is multiplicative with other damage mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Vectis}} installed with a max ranked '''Charged Chamber''' and {{M|Serration}} will deal {{Math|225 {{mul}} (1 + 165%) {{mul}} (1 + 40%)|t=y}} damage.
*Stacks additively with {{M|Primed Chamber}} for up to 140% bonus damage.
*'''Charged Chamber''' does not work with [[Sentinel]] weapons (you can fit it but there is no bonus damage).
*If used with [[Ammo Efficiency]] bonuses, it will provide bonus damage to a shot as long as the magazine counter is at <math>\text{Max Magazine} - 1</math> <u>after</u> a shot is fired.
**For example, a {{Weapon|Vulkar}} with {{A|Energized Munitions}} will have the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th shots buffed by Charged Chamber as the magazine counter is at {{Math|6 - 1|bf=y}} during those shots.
**When used alongside 100% ammo efficiency, make sure one shot is missing from the magazine, since the buff doesn't apply on a completely full one.

==Tips==
*This mod goes particularly well with the {{Weapon|Vectis}} as it has a one shot magazine, giving the bonus to all shots fired.

==Trivia==
*This is an Uncommon mod from a relatively rare enemy type, regularly drops on T3 [[Corpus]] [[Survival]]s. However, it is found occasionally in treasure rooms in [[Orokin Void]] missions.

The affected bow will only convert ammo while equipped, and will '''not''' convert any ammo type used by [[holster]]ed secondary weapons until their own ammo is full.

{{ModBox}}
'''Concealed Explosives''' is a [[mod]] that gives certain [[thrown]] secondary weapons a chance of exploding on impact of a surface or an enemy.

It can be used on the following weapons:
*{{Weapon|Despair}}
*{{Weapon|Fusilai}}
*{{Weapon|Hikou}} ({{Weapon|Hikou Prime|Prime}})
*{{Weapon|Kunai}} ({{Weapon|Mk1-Kunai|Mk1}})
*{{Weapon|Spira}} ({{Weapon|Spira Prime|Prime}})


==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
![[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
!Proc Chance
![[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
|0||+20%||6
|-
|1||+40%||7
|-
|2||+60%||8
|-
|3|| +80%||9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*The explosion deals 250 {{D|Blast}} damage to the target and any enemies within 10 meters of where the projectile lands.
**The radius can be increased with {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
**The explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
**The explosive damage from this mod is not increased by any base damage bonus, such as {{M|Hornet Strike}} or {{A|Eclipse}}, nor elemental mods such as {{M|Heated Charge}}, but it '''''is''''' increased by sources of Faction damage bonus such as {{M|Expel Infested}} and {{A|Roar}}.
*Cannot be used on {{Weapon|Castanas}} ({{Weapon|Sancti Castanas|Sancti}}), {{Weapon|Pox}}, {{Weapon|Staticor}} and {{Weapon|Talons}}. 
**Can be installed on {{Weapon|Aegrit}} and {{Weapon|Cantare}}, but does not have any effect.
*The explosions are silent.
*The explosions will only damage enemies that are within line of sight of the center of the explosion.
*The explosions themselves cannot proc [[Status Effect]]s or [[Critical Hit|crit]].
*The explosion damage is not affected by the Extinguished [[Dragon Key]].

==Tips==
*Pair with high-rank [[Multishot]] for maximum effect. You will have a 98.56% chance of at least one explosion at max rank with a maxed {{M|Barrel Diffusion}} and {{M|Lethal Torrent}}, and a 40.96% chance of ''three'' explosions.
*Can trigger guaranteed status procs from {{WF|Saryn}}'s {{A|Toxic Lash}}, {{WF|Oraxia}}'s {{A|Silken Stride}}, {{WF|Cyte-09}}'s {{A|Resupply}}, and {{WF|Uriel}}'s {{A|Demonium}}.
**{{WF|Lavos}}'s {{M|Valence Formation}} does '''not''' work, however.
*{{WF|Saryn}}'s {{A|Spores}} are easily popped by explosive projectiles, making weapons with this mod a very viable option to quickly spread the love.
* When facing groups of enemies at medium to long range, maximize splash damage by aiming for a nearby wall or floor surface rather than directly at an enemy.
*If a weapon equipped with this mod is modded for [[punch through]], the projectiles will pass through targets up to the listed amount, only being able to detonate afterward.
*{{WF|Mirage}}'s {{A|Hall of Mirrors}} clones will deal the full damage of the explosions.
* Because of their high fire rate and clip size, {{Weapon|Hikou}} and {{Weapon|Hikou Prime}} are excellent candidates for this mod.

==Bugs== 
*Concealed Explosives will not cause explosions when an enemy is directly hit with a thrown projectile. Players may get better results from the mod by aiming at the floor near the enemy instead.
*Hitting an enemy with only the explosion of Concealed Explosives can stack [[Secondary Enervate]] infinitely.

==See Also==
*{{M|Thunderbolt}}, the bow version.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32.3}}
*Fixed extremely bright FX when using the Concealed Explosives Mod on throwing Secondary weapons.

{{ver|30.8}}
*The explosion FX for Concealed Explosives have been updated.

{{ver|29.5}}
*Fixed Concealed Explosives not dealing explosive damage to nearby enemies when directly hit when equipped on Spira, Kunai, Hikou, Fusilai, or Despair.

{{ver|27.2}}
;Self Damage Changes:
We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. 

The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger.

With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe.

{{ver|18.0}}
*Fixed explosions from the Concealed Explosives﻿ Mod damaging Corpus Nullifiers through their bubbles.

{{ver|17}}
*Introduced.
}}

{{ModBox}} '''Energizing Shot''' is an [[:Category:Exilus Weapon Mods|Exilus mod]] for non-area of effect secondary weapons that allows picking up [[Energy Orb]]s when shooting at them, also increasing the amount gained by doing so. ==Acquisition== Obtainable from the [[Arbitrations]] vendor in the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}} room in [[Relay]]s for 30 {{Resource|Vitus Essence}}. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 0 |- | 1 || +20% || 1 |- | 2 || +30% || 2 |- | 3 || +40% || 3 |- | 4 || +50% || 4 |- | 5 || +60% || 5 |- | 6 || +70% || 6 |- | 7 || +80% || 7 |- | 8 || +90% || 8 |- | 9 || +100% || 9 |- | 10 || +110% || 10 |} ==Notes== *This mod '''cannot''' be equipped on the following explosive area-of-effect secondaries (with the hidden AOE compatibility tag): **{{Weapon|Aegrit}} **{{Weapon|Akarius}} ({{Weapon|Akarius Prime|Prime}}) **{{Weapon|Angstrum}} ({{Weapon|Prisma Angstrum|Prisma}}) **{{Weapon|Balefire Charger}} ({{Weapon|Balefire Charger Prime|Prime}}) **{{Weapon|Castanas}} ({{Weapon|Sancti Castanas|Sancti}}) **{{Weapon|Embolist}} **{{Weapon|Epitaph}} ({{Weapon|Epitaph Prime|Prime}}) **{{Weapon|Glory}} **{{Weapon|Kompressa}} **{{Weapon|Kulstar}} **{{Weapon|Laetum}} **{{Weapon|Noctua}} **{{Weapon|Pox}} **{{Weapon|Sepulcrum}} **{{Weapon|Staticor}} **{{Weapon|Stug}} **{{Weapon|Talons}} **{{Weapon|Tenet Plinx}} **{{Weapon|Tenet Spirex}} **{{Weapon|Tombfinger}} **{{Weapon|Zakti}} ({{Weapon|Zakti Prime|Prime}}) *Mutually exclusive with {{M|Concealed Explosives}} (cannot be equipped together). *Technically being an AoE weapon, the {{Weapon|Sonicor}} '''can''' equip this mod. Both its wide projectile '''and''' explosion will pick up Energy orbs. *This mod will make projectiles stop when hitting energy orbs, potentially wasting ammo. This can vary with hitscan weapons. **Weapons with [[Multishot]] can pick up energy orbs with just a single pellet/projectile. *Energy orbs picked up this way will trigger on-Energy-pickup effects, like {{Arcane|Arcane Energize}}, {{M|Energy Conversion}}, {{M|Equilibrium}} and {{Focus|Zenurik}}'s {{Focus|Energy Pulse}} bonus regeneration. **Zenurik's Energy Pulse scales off of the increased energy gained, while {{M|Equilibrium}} (including {{WF|Equinox}}'s passive) ''' does not'''. ***Bonus does affect {{M|Equilibrium}}'s conversion on Energy Orbs from dispensers in [[Arena]] gamemodes. *Energy orbs picked up this way during [[bleedout]] will revive the player if {{M|Equilibrium}} is equipped. *Increased Energy Orb Effectiveness is additive with the similar increase from {{Resource|Amber Archon Shard}}, but multiplicative with {{WF|Dagath}}'s Passive. *Works across the material and [[Rift Plane|Rift]] planes. ==Tips== *This mod is useful when paired with channeled abilities like {{WF|Oberon}}'s {{A|Renewal}} or {{WF|Nyx}}'s {{A|Absorb}} (with {{M|Assimilate}} on) when energy sources are scarce and you want to get the most out of Energy orbs. *Somewhat useful when paired with abilities that produce energy orbs, like {{WF|Hildryn}}'s {{A|Aegis Storm}}.  *Most useful when paired with weapons that have qualities of one or more of the following: High firerate, Area of Effect, moderate inaccuracy or spread. As such, it will allow collection of higher energy at range without the need to focus on specifically shooting the energy orbs themselves. For example, the {{Weapon|Quatz}} has the ability to burst down enemies quickly with its aimed burst fire, collect the energy orb in the same breath with its unaimed automatic fire mode, or collect a number of energy orbs in range with its empty reload electric pulse which can allow a level of regeneration rivaling {{Arcane|Arcane Energize}} or {{Arcane|Exodia Brave}}.  ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38.6}} *Exalted Weapons can now equip Energizing Shot (excluding Jade’s Glory, Hildryn’s Balefire and Dante’s Noctua since they are AOE weapons). {{ver|38.5}} *Fixed Energizing Shot not working while riding K-Drive and Merulina. {{ver|37}} *Fixed Cantare not benefitting from Energizing Shot. {{ver|33}} *Fixed the Energizing Shot Mod working on the Tenet Plinx’ and Tenet Spirex’ AOE. **''As indicated in the mod’s description, it is intended not to work on AOE.'' {{ver|27.3}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{M|Mending Shot}}, the primary equivalent for [[Pickups#Health|Health Orbs]]. {{SecondaryMods}} [[es:Disparo energizante]] [[fr:Tir Énergisant]] [[ru:Бодрящий Выстрел]] [[uk:Заряджальний постріл]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Exilus Weapon Mods]]

*Enemies must be within [[Affinity Range]] for the effect to apply.
*Cannot be equipped alongside {{M|Fass Canticle}}, {{M|Khra Canticle}}, and {{M|Lohk Canticle}}.
*Tome Mods with on-kill conditions do not require the Tome weapon to make the killing blow. Instead it has to damage an enemy at least once to mark it with the Tome effect and then be the held weapon when marked enemies are killed by an other source, such as Warframe abilities or companions.
